summary: Phase 9B completed local Internal Trial Result Review Framework work: anonymous/mock result review model, issue taxonomy, decision framework, administrator review panels, result review documents, issue taxonomy documentation, and decision framework documentation. It did not add production app, public recruitment, backend, camera, AR, analytics, AI analysis, OpenAI/external API usage, training, App Store/TestFlight, online release, or real user record collection.

routeDecision.futureAppOwnership: separate user-facing app surface/repository after a future explicit phase gate
routeDecision.makeupEngineOwnership: template production, package export, local contract prototype, PWA/mobile polish evidence, trial pack, content QA evidence, and release readiness evidence only
phase8BResult: ordinary user path separated from administrator QA
deferredRoutes: ecommerce, community, paid features, analytics, app store release, and model training

nextAction: Proceed to Phase 9C: Internal Trial Iteration Plan. Phase 9B is complete. Turn anonymous/mock internal trial review decisions into scoped iteration plans without adding production app, public recruitment, backend, database, camera, AR, training, OpenAI API, external API, native iOS, React Native, Flutter, ecommerce, community, paid features, analytics, accounts, online publication, App Store/TestFlight, service worker, offline cache, push notification, background sync, install tracking, AI analysis, or real user data collection.
risks: Letting Phase 9C become production roadmap execution instead of a local internal iteration plan
Treating Phase 9B review decisions as real analytics or public research data
Collecting real names, contact information, photos, health data, sensitive identity data, analytics records, backend records, or training data before a future explicit approval gate
Weakening UserAppTemplatePackage as the stable handoff contract
forbiddenActions: Do not treat Phase 9B internal trial result review, issue taxonomy, or decision framework as production analytics, public recruitment, production release, App Store/TestFlight, backend forms, analytics, camera readiness, AR readiness, AI analysis approval, OpenAI/external API approval, training readiness, online publication, or real user data collection approval.

Do not use Phase 9B anonymous/mock review signals as permission to collect real user names, contacts, photos, health information, sensitive identity data, biometrics, backend records, analytics records, or training data.
Do not mutate UserAppTemplatePackage from Phase 9B result review, issue taxonomy, decision framework, sessions, preferences, recommendations, content QA, feedback, or admin panels.
Do not write real internal trial participant records into project-state or training datasets.
Do not train directly from SourceImagePackage or user photo/profile/preference/recommendation/session/readiness/browser QA/release readiness/go-no-go/operations/observation/outcome/review data.
Do not expand legacy frozen modules.
Do not weaken the UserAppTemplatePackage boundary; the future React Web / PWA MVP must consume exported contract data and cannot mutate Makeup Engine production state.
